method: Manual whole-prayer-form comparison of canonical EN/FR/LA against published 2005 Vatican Compendium originals (URL + web extracted line windows). Records phrase-level assertions checked against the source-of-truth corpus; not a machine-extracted diplomatic transcript.
provenance: Published Vatican Compendium text directly inspected; previously verified source-anchor and locale comparisons reconciled.
disclaimer: Original text is not duplicated in this dataset; source text is linked. Source extraction line coordinates are ephemeral, not print-page references. No verbatim publication certification or claim of 1962 equivalence.

editorial_release_policy: Maintain liturgical/traditional French wording when a modern Compendium prayer uses different text.
Present source URL as a witness/comparator, not automatic verbatim edition certification.
Preserve the attested French Act of Hope anomaly until a differently printed French original is separately verified.
Do not delete common terminal Amen or force French local Acts to match longer English/Latin forms.
Each future canonical text replacement requires its exact new original and independent language/rights sign-off.
